1: Allah un ghoron ki qasam khata hai jo itna sakht daudte hain ke un ki saans suni ja sakti hai.
2: Aur woh un ghoron ki bhi qasam khata hai jo jab apne naal zor se pattharon par maarte hain to chingariyan nikalti hain.
3: Aur woh un ghoron ki bhi qasam khata hai jo subah-dam dushman par chhapa maarte hain,
4: aur apne daudne se dhool uthate hain,
5: phir apne sawaron ko mil kar dushman ke beech le jaate hain.
6: Beshak insan us bhalai mein hichkichata hai jo us ka Rubb us se chahta hai.
7: Aur beshak woh us bhalai par khud gawah hai jis ke dene mein woh hichkichata hai; woh us ki wuzahat ki wajah se us ka inkaar nahin kar sakta.
8: Aur beshak woh apne maal mein bakheeli karta hai, us se shiddat ki mohabbat ki wajah se.
9: Kya yeh insan, jo duniya ki zindagi ke dhoke mein hai, nahin jaanta ke jab Allah murdon ko un ki qabron se zinda karega aur unhein zameen se nikal kar hisaab aur badle ke liye le jayega, to maamla waisa na hoga jaisa woh samajhta hai?
10: Aur dilon ke andar jo niyatein aur aqeede hain, woh wazeh aur zahir kar diye jayenge.
11: Beshak un ka Rubb us din un ke har maamle se khabardar hoga; us ke bandon ka koi maamla us se chhupa na hoga, aur woh unhein usi ka badla dega.
